scope: Bounded engineering review supplementing the hash-bound project food, town and siting products. No new comprehensive review, cave survey or source-price validation.

sources.citation: Martin and Benaroya (2023). Pressurized lunar lava tubes for habitation. Acta Astronautica 204, 157–174.
sources.retrieval: Publisher indexed abstract and section preview read. Direct publisher access returned 403; Rutgers repository PDF retrieval also failed. Full paper remains unretrieved.
sources.use: Pressure-induced failure in the models motivates independent pressure containment; the preview does not establish a universal maximum pressure or qualify any actual tube. No numerical rock allowable is transferred.

sources.citation: Johnson et al. (2021). Supplemental Food Production With Plants: A Review of NASA Research. Frontiers in Astronomy and Space Sciences 8, 734343.
sources.retrieval: Abstract, introduction and discussion read from publisher HTML.
sources.use: Ground-based crop area estimates of about 40–50 square metres per person for calories; lunar agriculture and complete nutrition remain unvalidated.

sources.citation: NASA (2023; page updated 2026). NASA Achieves Water Recovery Milestone on International Space Station.
sources.use: 98% recovery within the collected station-water system. Does not justify 98% or 99.5% whole-city closure; crop, fish and industrial loops have separate assumed recoveries.

inherited_reading: The bound food-system source register retains original source identity, evidence notes and prior reading coverage. This study reuses those reviewed coefficients without claiming new full-paper reading.

parameter_status.observed_precedents: Ground-based crop yield and photon demand, measured lamp efficacy, commercial aquaculture energy/water/feed precedents, station water recovery.
parameter_status.engineering_assumptions: Cavity dimensions, pressure-module arrangement and reinforcement allowable; all installation masses, nutrient and water recovery, capacity margins, useful lives, production rates, labour and U prices.
parameter_status.design_limits: No confirmed city-sized void, qualified pressure joint, full menu, element-by-element nutrient closure, lunar crop/fish trial, radiator or beamed-power system design.
